## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Is it related to a hardware path (SM100/SM90), a subsystem (scheduler, cache, model, server), or a workflow limitation?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible — include relevant API design, data structure choices, or algorithmic references (papers, other systems).

## Hardware Impact

Does this affect the SM100 (Blackwell B200) or SM90 (Hopper H200) path differently? Please specify.

- [ ] SM100 only
- [ ] SM90 only
- [ ] Both
- [ ] Hardware-agnostic

## Affected Crate(s)

- [ ] `singularity-core`
- [ ] `singularity-cuda`
- [ ] `singularity-cache`
- [ ] `singularity-scheduler`
- [ ] `singularity-model`
- [ ] `singularity-grammar`
- [ ] `singularity-server`
- [ ] `singularity-cli`
- [ ] `singularity-tests`
- [ ] Infrastructure / CI

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered alternative approaches? Why were they rejected?

## Additional Context

Links to papers, reference implementations, or prior art.
